image_spec.headline: How many jars of cinnamon are in your cabinet right now?
image_spec.body: One, two, or the one you bought because the first was hiding. Tell us in the comments.

posts.caption:
Be honest. How many jars of cinnamon are in your cabinet right now?

If it's more than one, you're in good company. Most of us have bought a second jar because the first one was hiding behind the soy sauce. Then a third, because the second one was hiding too.

That little moment is a big reason we're building StashSmart. Drop your number in the comments. Bonus points if your duplicate isn't cinnamon. 🙌

image_spec.headline: About 20% of food wasted at home is tossed over confusing date labels.
image_spec.body: “Best if used by” means peak quality, not food safety.

posts.caption:
About 20% of the food we throw out at home goes because of date labels, according to the FDA.

Here's the part most of us were never told. "Best if used by" is about when food tastes its best, not when it stops being safe. The FDA has been nudging food makers toward that one phrase so it's less confusing.

We all do the sniff test on the yogurt anyway. StashSmart will give you a heads-up 48 hours before something at home is about to turn, so you can use it first. 🥛

Coming soon on iPhone. Follow along.
